title: Chart quiz #5
caption:
Chart quiz #5. Three charts, three calls.

Q1: Name the pattern
Q2: Breakdown, or bear trap?
Q3: Which trade plan is better?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #ChartPatterns #BearTrap #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Patterns, traps and trade plans. Question one. Three peaks, with the middle one highest. What's the pattern? Head and shoulders, cup and handle, or double bottom? Head and shoulders. A left shoulder, a higher head, a lower right shoulder, and then the neckline gave way. It's a bearish pattern, but only once that neckline breaks. Question two. Price just dipped below support. Is this a real breakdown, or a bear trap? A bear trap. The dip came on thin volume, then buyers snapped it straight back above support. Sellers who shorted the break got caught. Question three. Same entry, two plans. Green is the target, red is the stop. Is plan A better, or plan B? Plan B. Plan A risks as much as it can make. Plan B risks a little to make several times more. You can be wrong more often, and still come out ahead. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
